اهتديتما (form VIII)
# اِهْتَدَيْتُمَا (ihtadaytumā) /ih.ta.daj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# اُهْتُدِيتُمَا (uhtudītumā) /uh.tu.diː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
